snippet.title: Chronicles of the Wolf - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description: Watch the Launch Trailer for Chronicles of the Wolf, a 2D action-adventure platformer developed by PixelHeart. Players will step into the role of Mateo Lombardo to hunt powerful and legendary beasts of Gevaudan to beat bosses, explore castles, and uncover deep secrets. Chronicles of the Wolf is available now for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).
